defect.title: Commerce POST /orders, /orders/{id}/payment-intents, /orders/{id}/refunds denied at Spring layer (403 policy-denied) while sibling POSTs pass with identical auth
bisect: GET /internal/v1/commerce/orders -> 200; POST same path+token -> 403 (direct, no gateway)
POST /activation-codes/redeem -> 409 service logic; POST /orders/{id}/cancel -> 404 service logic
no-auth POST /orders -> 401 (entry point works); missing/short Idempotency-Key -> 400 service validation (reaches controller)
excluded: CSRF: disabled in source AND confirmed in running bytecode (CsrfConfigurer.disable invoked); redeem/cancel POSTs pass the same filters
config is method-agnostic (single chain, /internal/** authenticated(), anyRequest denyAll); no @PreAuthorize; no second chain
single process owns 18096 (PID verified); single CommerceController class in jar; bytecode carries all mappings with correct values
gateway uninvolved (direct calls reproduce); token valid (GETs + redeem + cancel pass with it)
defect.correlation: the three denied handlers are exactly the ones carrying @ResponseStatus(CREATED/ACCEPTED); no Spring Security mechanism is known to inspect that annotation
defect.hypothesis: MvcRequestMatcher handler-existence semantics would explain every cell iff the three methods were absent from runtime handler mappings despite correct bytecode; needs TRACE-level confirmation on next bounce
defect.impact: order.create/payment.start/refund sandbox flows unreachable; W3 covers streak/quests/claim+replay/games/rooms/join/focus/leaderboards/reports/skus/entitlements/redeem-negative/readiness live
defect.rootCause: commerce outbox writer kept the legacy 12-column shape; V2 standardize migration tightened event_name/dedupe_key/occurred_at to NOT NULL, so every order/payment/refund write rolled back; the exception forwarded to /error which anyRequest().denyAll() masks as 403. CSRF/MvcRequestMatcher theories falsified by TRACE.
defect.fix: JdbcCommerceOutboxPort now writes event_name/dedupe_key/occurred_at; all 5 sibling writers audited clean.
